_real_world.class: AN/SLQ-32B(V)6 electronic warfare suite with SEWIP Block 2
_real_world.variant_scope: CVN-78 Ford fit; the DDG-51 CSG-S0 records reuse the existing SLQ-32_Passive_ESM_MVP module instead of this one.

_provenance.modeling_note: Passive ESM proxy for the Ford's AN/SLQ-32B(V)6 with SEWIP Block 2. No public detection range or sensitivity exists; the range and noise values are copied unchanged from the repo's existing SLQ-32_Passive_ESM_MVP template (bearing-only maritime ESM MVP), which itself is a community-derived approximation, since SEWIP Block 2 is a sensitivity/processing upgrade over the baseline SLQ-32 and no admissible source quantifies the improvement.

sensor.type.note: SLQ-32B(V)6 is an electronic support measures suite; ESM is the matching engine sensor type

sensor.max_range.note: copied from ships/modules/sensors/slq_32_passive_esm_mvp.json; no public SEWIP Block 2 sensitivity/range delta over baseline SLQ-32

sensor.range_noise_std.note: 0.0: bearing-only ESM has no independent range measurement, copied from template

sensor.range_power.note: radar-equation exponent, standard engine default, copied from template

sensor.aspect_influence.note: 0.0 disables RCS aspect-angle modeling, copied from template

sensor.doppler_notch_width.note: 0.0: not applicable to a passive ESM receiver, copied from template

sensor.reference_snr_db.note: radar-equation calibration constant copied from template, paired with reference_range_m/reference_rcs_m2

sensor.reference_range_m.note: paired calibration constant, see reference_snr_db; copied from template

sensor.reference_rcs_m2.note: 5 m^2 generic reference emitter/RCS, engine convention, copied from template

sensor.bearing_only.note: true: ESM systems detect and bear emitters passively, no independent ranging; copied from template convention

sensor.environment_domain.note: surface/maritime domain selected for a shipborne ESM suite per authoring standard
